messages:
Maya CSM: Heads up — Solenex renewal is queued for e-sign today but RevOps blocked on vendor_code mismatch and Legal flagged an SSO clause change. Need quick sync to avoid delaying onboarding start.
Rafael AE: On my side customer signed LOI, they asked to move to 9mo term and want ramp credits. We already priced 12->9 with a small discount — quote updated.
Tom RevOps: Vendor code mismatch: their PO uses 'SOL-INC' but billing system expects 'SOLENEX-US'. If we change invoice entity their finance needs vendor_code 'V-9981'. What's the recommended path?
Maya CSM: Can we add vendor_code to DocuSign metadata? If not, Tom can we do interim manual PO acceptance and then amend invoice?
Tom RevOps: We prefer putting vendor_code on the invoice. Quick fix: accept PO as 'SOL-INC' then send corrected invoice with vendor_code V-9981. Need legal OK for net30 vs net45 change.
Lina Legal: I reviewed the 9mo term clause. We need an SSO addendum (customer requested) and to confirm indemnity limit stays same. I'm okay with manual invoice flow but add a clause in DocuSign to note 'invoice to follow with vendor_code V-9981'.
Maya CSM: :thumbsup: I'll update the DocuSign recipients and add a note in the envelope. Rafael — confirm customer accepts 9mo price and credits.
Rafael AE: Chatted w/ procurement. They accepted 9mo and credits, but procurement insists on vendor_code on the PO. Asking for our finance contact to annotate the PO PDF before signing.
Tom RevOps: I can patch the PO PDF with vendor_code + finance email. Paste below for audit header I'll add: 

INVOICE_VENDOR_CODE: V-9981
FINANCE_CONTACT: finance@redwood-inference.com

Will that work?
Lina Legal: Fine as long as the patch doesn't alter key terms. Add a short attestation line: 'Redwood attests this addition is administrative only.'
Maya CSM: Great. Nora Onboard — customer's preferred onboarding start is 2026-05-04. If e-sign completes today, can we still hit that date?
Nora Onboard: Yes but we need access request form from Solenex and a kickoff prep call. Can we schedule the enablement 5/6 to leave buffer? I'll draft the checklist.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 0x8a3 queued — failed to deliver to procurement@solenex.com: recipient_email_mismatch. Reason: domain mismatch. Suggested action: resend to procurement@solenex-inc.com or manual delivery.
Maya CSM: Procurement email mismatch — Rafael do you have updated recipient? I'll resend after Tom attaches vendor_code header.
Rafael AE: Procurement says correct email is procurement@solenex-inc.com. I'll DM procurement contact to expect resend. Also attach the amended PO per Tom.
Maya CSM: Plan: Tom attaches patch (V-9981), I update envelope note + add legal attestation, Rafael resends to correct procurement email, Nora schedules enablement 5/6. Re-check here once envelope sends. :rocket:
Tom RevOps: Patch attached to thread: invoice_header_v9981.pdf (uploaded). Doing the resend now.
docusign-bot: Envelope 0x8a3 delivered to procurement@solenex-inc.com at 1778884435. Status: completed by Solenex procurement. Envelope now awaiting internal finance counter-signature.
Maya CSM: Finance — can you counter-sign today? if not, we risk sliding onboarding.
Tom RevOps: Finance confirms will counter-sign by EOD.
Maya CSM: Awesome. Closing loop — Rafael, please capture feedback from procurement about why vendor_code mismatch happened; we'll log as process improvement. Adding to renewal board.
Rafael AE: Will do. I'll add brief note: 'Procurement has legacy PO template. Need vendor_code field mapping doc.'
